messages:
maya_csm: Heads-up  we have ~12 onboarding tenants with delayed activations between 03:20-03:48 UTC on 2026-07-14. Flagged 2 renewal-risk accounts. Need a short external status + RCA + office hours invite.

oliver_cs: Acknowledged. Any Dedicated pools impacted? That affects credits wording. :thinking: 

sam_sre: notify_bot created INC-2026-0714-03 at 6101111800. Quick triage: an upstream worker backpressure event caused retries and a replay backlog for shared onboarding pipelines. Not a code deploy.

li_infra: Metrics: ingest_backlog peaked at 154 -> baseline ~20. Throttle and replay applied at 6101111950; replays started at 6101112000 and are ~50% complete.

maya_csm: Draft external note: ```We experienced delayed onboarding activations for some accounts between 03:20-03:48 UTC on 2026-07-14. Root cause: transient backpressure in our ingestion pipeline that caused retries and replay. What we did: applied throttling to prevent amplification, replayed missed batches, and are monitoring progress. Status: replays ~50% complete; most accounts are processing normally. Next steps: full replay expected within 6 hours. Office hours at 16:00 UTC today (link). Compensation: eligible affected customers will receive a pro-rated onboarding credit; CS will follow up. Apologies for the disruption.  Redwood Inference Team```

oliver_cs: LGTM. Add a tiny validation checklist: (1) check index doc counts, (2) run a sample query, (3) report missing docs. Include this curl: ```curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/indexes/<id>/stats | jq .doc_count```

sam_sre: SRE ack. Added short-term alert for ingest_backlog > 50 (created 6101112100). Will ping CS if any replay falls behind >8h.

li_infra: Postmortem summary for CS: root cause = transient downstream backpressure + retry amplification; fix = throttling guard + replay idempotency checks. Full postmortem ETA EOD 2026-07-14.

maya_csm: Thanks team. Oliver  please send to affected list and CC me. I'll own renewal-risk outreach and credit eligibility.
